server.title: Sign in
server.invalid: That is not the address of a server, such as files.example.com.
server.unreachable: {server} is not a Transferly server, or it cannot be reached.

approval.title: Approve in your browser
approval.opened: Your browser opened this address. Sign in there and approve transferly-tui on {host}.
approval.notOpened: Open this address in your browser, sign in there and approve transferly-tui on {host}.
approval.noBrowser: No browser here? Press p and paste the code the page shows.
approval.keys: o open again · c copy · p paste a code · Esc back
approval.denied: The sign-in was denied in the browser.

paste.title: Paste the code
paste.intro: Open this address on any device, sign in and approve:
paste.then: Then paste the code the page shows.
paste.note: The code works once, for 5 minutes.

exchange.invalid_grant: The code is not valid any more: it works once, for 5 minutes. Sign in again.
exchange.cli_login_disabled: This server has signing in from the terminal turned off; ask its administrator.
exchange.http_404: This server is too old to sign in from the terminal: update it.
exchange.notKept: Signed in, but the token could not be kept: {reason}

main.small: Make the window at least 60 × 16 to use the client.
main.noSites: No sites in this workspace yet. Add them in the web.
main.pickSite: Choose a site on the left and press Enter.
main.explorerSoon: The files of the site will show here: the explorer is not ready yet.
main.versions: server {server}, client {client}: update the one behind
main.tooOld: This server is too old for that: update it.
main.ended: The session ended. Sign in again.
main.notSaved: The settings could not be kept: {reason}
main.keysSites: Enter open · w workspace · / commands · ? help · q quit
main.keysExplorer: Tab sites · / commands · ? help · q quit

commands.title: Commands
commands.hint: ↑↓ choose · Tab complete · Enter run · Esc close
commands.config: settings: language, theme, colors, keys of files
commands.theme: wear another theme, shared with the web
commands.language: English or Español, shared with the web
commands.server: switch to another server or add one

settings.title: Settings
settings.keys: ↑↓ choose · ←→ change · Enter list · Esc close
settings.timezoneWeb: The time zone is changed in the web, in Settings.
settings.note: Settings of the account follow it to the web and every computer; the others stay on this one.

vault.title: Unlock the vault
vault.intro: Your vault is locked. Enter your master password to unlock it for this session.
vault.forSite: The credentials of {site} are in your vault. Enter your master password to unlock it for this session.
vault.wrong: That master password is not right.
vault.limited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
